criteriaCoverage.originalIntent: Evaluate whether FCM notifications are mobile-friendly for iOS/Android, identify security gaps and functional improvements, and judge extensibility for future notification use cases.
criteriaCoverage.desiredOutcome: A code-and-settings-backed Korean audit report with exact file:line evidence, Firebase documentation references, security/abuse findings, and extension recommendations, with ULW evidence and cleanup receipts.
criteriaCoverage.userOutcomeReview: The report now gives a direct verdict: baseline mobile push works, but platform-native options and payload contract are incomplete; security must improve target/data/deepLink validation and token-registration abuse defenses; extensibility is good for current member/org audiences but medium for new audience axes and platform semantics.
